title: Fr\'echet Regression on the Bures-Wasserstein Manifold
abstract: arXiv:2604.03566v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fr\'echet regression, or conditional Barycenters, is a flexible framework for modeling relationships between covariates (usually Euclidean) and response variables on general metric spaces, e.g., probability distributions or positive definite matrices. However, in contrast to classical barycenter problems, computing conditional counterparts in many non-Euclidean spaces remains an open challenge, as they yield non-convex optimization problems with an affine structure. In this work, we study the existence and computation of conditional barycenters, specifically in the space of positive-definite matrices with the Bures-Wasserstein metric. We provide a sufficient condition for the existence of a minimizer of the conditional barycenter problem that characterizes the regression range of extrapolation. Moreover, we further characterize the optimization landscape, proving that under this condition, the objective is free of local maxima.

translated_abstract: Fréchet回归，也称条件重心，是一个灵活的框架，用于在一般度量空间（如概率分布或正定矩阵）上建模协变量（通常是欧几里得空间中的）与响应变量之间的关系。然而，与经典重心问题不同，在许多非欧几里得空间中计算条件重心仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战，因为它们会产生具有仿射结构的非凸优化问题。在这项工作中，我们研究了条件重心的存在性与计算，特别是在配备Bures-Wasserstein度量的正定矩阵空间中。我们为条件重心问题极小值点的存在性提供了一个充分条件，该条件刻画了回归的外推范围。此外，我们进一步刻画了优化景观，证明在该条件下，目标函数不存在局部极大值。
tldr: 本文研究了Bures-Wasserstein度量下正定矩阵空间中条件重心（Fréchet回归）的存在性与计算，给出了极小值点存在的充分条件，并证明在该条件下目标函数不存在局部极大值。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the existence and computation of conditional barycenters (Fréchet regression) on the space of positive-definite matrices with the Bures-Wasserstein metric, providing a sufficient condition for the existence of a minimizer and proving that the objective function is free of local maxima under this condition.
